Built one relationship at a time.

Independent and local. A hometown brokerage in Cumberland, not a franchise office.
New chapter, August 2026. Josh DeBrossard was announced as the new Broker Owner on 24 August 2026.
Now open on Broad Street. The doors opened with a grand opening celebration on Friday 13 November 2026.

Stateline Real Estate serves buyers, sellers and investors from its home on Broad Street in Cumberland. The name says the idea plainly. Life does not stop at a state line, and neither does a move.

A family growing out of a house in Rhode Island might find the next one just over the line in Massachusetts. A first investment might sit in Connecticut. One local brokerage, one relationship, across all three.

That is the thread through every post the brokerage shares. Start with the person, learn what they need, and let the map follow.

One brokerage. Three states.

Rhode Island is home. Massachusetts and Connecticut are right next door. Stateline works across all three, so a move in any direction stays with the same trusted team.

The state line is a line on a map. It is not a wall.
